probe_only INDEX_EN cases; source records non-window-local phase and modulo-8 coordinate aliasing that are not host-derivable. The clean maximum_indices case is bundled; the padded 3x3/stride-2 geometry is bundled without INDEX_EN.

larger isolated probes (8x8 kernel/pad7, 16x16 kernel/stride); the requested small-shape matrix uses 1x1/2x2/3x3/3x5 cases.
the source hardcoded matrix has no padded INT8/INT16 case; padded windows are covered by FP16 only. No integer padded variant was invented without source evidence.
